correctness.rationale: The fixed set is exactly two plane sextic curves by projective eigenplane decomposition, and their anti-normal bundle has rank three and weights -1, forcing transverse 1/2(1,1,1) terminal singularities. Blowing up the Veronese cone yields a smooth O(-2) neighborhood with discrepancy (2-1)/2=1/2. The smooth sextic Jacobian ring is A⊗A with Hilbert (1+s+...+s^4)^6, and the residue involution is minus swap; invariant Hodge dimensions are (0,208,866,208,0), plus hyperplane. Codimension-three blowup adds exactly two copies of H(C)(-1)+H(C)(-2). The checker rederives all numerical identities, and standard Lefschetz/Armstrong results justify ordinary fundamental groups. Limits of computational verification are explicit.

value.rationale: The sextic fourfold is singled out by recent Hodge-coniveau research. The result identifies the full terminal non-Gorenstein quotient stratum, exceptional birational geometry and discrepancy, together with complete rational cohomology/Hodge data of both quotient and concrete smooth resolution, uniformly across every smooth plane sextic. This is a natural global classification with immediate application to birational and Hodge comparison, not an arbitrary parameter slice; it leaves integral and intersection cohomology for future investigation.
